$comment: (atlas-ui-parts) OPEN QUESTIONS for the initiative axis (scripts/atlas-eval/initiative.mjs). Each is a short, ordinary question of the kind a reader types with no instruction about HOW to show the answer. None has a verified answer, an expected capability or an expected map: the axis asks whether the reply brought a representation or analysis the reader did not request but would want, and a set that named one would be a set to memorise.

The subjects are deliberately unrelated to each other (climate, cities, migration, industry, transport, water). Add a question only if it names no output form (map, chart, shading, switch) and no dataset; replace one when it starts to be answered from memory of the set.

questions.text: How has the climate of the Mediterranean region been changing, and who will feel it most?
東京と他のアジアの大都市は、この50年でどう違う広がり方をしてきたの？
Where do people move to and from in Africa, and why does it matter?
半導体産業はなぜ今の場所に集まっているの？
Explain how trade between Europe and East Asia physically moves, and where it is fragile.
Where does the drinking water for the big cities of South Asia come from, and how secure is it?
